items.title: Is Clorox (CLX) Reasonably Priced on Its Earnings Today?
items.summary: Clorox has seen its share price fall sharply over recent years, which puts fresh attention on what investors are really paying for its earnings today. With the stock back near levels that some long term holders may not have expected, the key issue is how well the current price lines up with the profits the business is generating.
